head.script: (function(){var FLAG="niche-onboarded";try{if(localStorage.getItem(FLAG))return}catch(e){return}var THEMES=[{id:"dark",name:"Dark",dots:["#000000","#111111","#ffffff"]},{id:"halloween",name:"Ember",dots:["#0a0705","#120c07","#d99a5f"]},{id:"red",name:"Crimson",dots:["#0d0807","#150c0a","#d67f6d"]},{id:"green",name:"Moss",dots:["#070a07","#0c110b","#a3b18a"]},{id:"white",name:"White",dots:["#f4f1ea","#ffffff","#2f5d8a"]},{id:"ocean",name:"Ocean Blue",dots:["#060b10","#0a1218","#5aa9e6"]}];var CLOAKS=[{id:"classroom",name:"Google Classroom",title:"Home - Classroom",icon:"https://www.gstatic.com/classroom/ic_product_classroom_32.png"},{id:"docs",name:"Google Docs",title:"Google Docs",icon:"https://docs.google.com/favicon.ico"},{id:"drive",name:"Google Drive",title:"Home - Google Drive",icon:"https://drive.google.com/favicon.ico"}];var step=0;var root,body;function el(tag,cls,text){var d=document.createElement(tag);if(cls)d.className=cls;if(text!=null)d.textContent=text;return d}function curTheme(){try{if(typeof window.nicheGetTheme==="function")return window.nicheGetTheme();return localStorage.getItem("niche-theme")||"dark"}catch(e){return"dark"}}function finish(){try{localStorage.setItem(FLAG,"1")}catch(e){}if(root&&root.parentNode)root.parentNode.removeChild(root)}function dotsRow(n){var w=el("div","niche-ob-dots");for(var i=0;i<n;i++){var s=el("span");if(i===step)s.className="on";w.appendChild(s)}return w}function navRow(back,nextLabel,onNext){var nav=el("div","niche-ob-nav");var skip=el("button","niche-ob-btn ghost","Skip");skip.type="button";skip.addEventListener("click",finish);var right=el("div");right.style.display="flex";right.style.gap="8px";if(back){var b=el("button","niche-ob-btn ghost","Back");b.type="button";b.addEventListener("click",function(){step--;render()});right.appendChild(b)}var nx=el("button","niche-ob-btn",nextLabel);nx.type="button";nx.addEventListener("click",onNext);right.appendChild(nx);nav.appendChild(skip);nav.appendChild(right);return nav}function storeDirect(url){try{localStorage.setItem("niche-wallpaper",url)}catch(e){return false}try{if(typeof window.nicheSetWallpaper==="function")window.nicheSetWallpaper(url)}catch(e2){}return true}function applyCloak(c){if(c&&c.title)document.title=c.title;var link=document.querySelector('link[rel="icon"]');if(c&&c.icon){if(!link){link=document.createElement("link");link.rel="icon";document.head.appendChild(link)}link.href=c.icon}else if(link)link.removeAttribute("href");try{if(c)localStorage.setItem("niche-cloak",JSON.stringify(c));else localStorage.removeItem("niche-cloak")}catch(e){}}function themePills(box){var cur=curTheme();THEMES.forEach(function(th){var b=el("button","niche-ob-pill"+(th.id===cur?" on":""));b.type="button";th.dots.forEach(function(c){var d=el("span","dot");d.style.background=c;b.appendChild(d)});b.appendChild(el("span",null,th.name));b.addEventListener("click",function(){try{if(typeof window.nicheSetTheme==="function")window.nicheSetTheme(th.id);else{localStorage.setItem("niche-theme",th.id);localStorage.setItem("niche-dark","1")}}catch(e){}render()});box.appendChild(b)})}function wallpaperRow(){var row=el("div","niche-ob-row");var img=el("img");img.alt="";try{var cur=typeof window.nicheGetWallpaper==="function"?window.nicheGetWallpaper():localStorage.getItem("niche-wallpaper");if(cur)img.src=cur}catch(e){}var grow=el("div","grow","Backdrop behind panels. Saved on this device.");var lab=el("label","niche-ob-btn","Choose");lab.setAttribute("for","niche-ob-file");var inp=document.createElement("input");inp.type="file";inp.id="niche-ob-file";inp.accept="image/*";inp.style.display="none";inp.addEventListener("change",function(e){var f=e.target.files&&e.target.files[0];if(!f)return;var rd=new FileReader;rd.onload=function(){try{if(storeDirect(rd.result)){img.src=rd.result;return}}catch(e2){}var im=new Image;im.onload=function(){var steps=[[2560,.9],[1920,.82],[1280,.75]];for(var i=0;i<steps.length;i++){try{var sc=Math.min(1,steps[i][0]/Math.max(im.width,im.height));var cv=document.createElement("canvas");cv.width=Math.max(1,Math.round(im.width*sc));cv.height=Math.max(1,Math.round(im.height*sc));cv.getContext("2d").drawImage(im,0,0,cv.width,cv.height);if(storeDirect(cv.toDataURL("image/jpeg",steps[i][1]))){img.src=cv.toDataURL("image/jpeg",steps[i][1]);return}}catch(err){}}};im.src=rd.result};rd.readAsDataURL(f);e.target.value=""});row.appendChild(img);row.appendChild(grow);row.appendChild(lab);row.appendChild(inp);return row}function cloakPills(box,done){var cur=null;try{cur=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("niche-cloak")||"null")}catch(e){}CLOAKS.forEach(function(cl){var b=el("button","niche-ob-pill"+(cur&&cur.id===cl.id?" on":""));b.type="button";var im=el("img","dot");im.src=cl.icon;im.alt="";b.appendChild(im);b.appendChild(el("span",null,cl.name));b.addEventListener("click",function(){applyCloak({id:cl.id,title:cl.title,icon:cl.icon});done(true)});box.appendChild(b)})}function render(){body.innerHTML="";body.appendChild(dotsRow(3));if(step===0){body.appendChild(el("h1",null,"Welcome to Niche"));body.appendChild(el("p",null,"Two quick steps to make it yours. You can change everything later in Settings."));body.appendChild(navRow(false,"Next",function(){step=1;render()}))}else if(step===1){body.appendChild(el("h1",null,"Make it yours"));body.appendChild(el("h2",null,"Theme"));var tp=el("div","niche-ob-pills");themePills(tp);body.appendChild(tp);body.appendChild(el("h2",null,"Wallpaper"));body.appendChild(wallpaperRow());body.appendChild(navRow(true,"Next",function(){step=2;render()}))}else{body.appendChild(el("h1",null,"Tab cloak"));body.appendChild(el("p",null,"Disguise this tab instantly. No refresh needed."));var cp=el("div","niche-ob-pills");var picked=false;cloakPills(cp,function(){picked=true;render()});body.appendChild(cp);var t=el("div",null,null);var tl=el("label","niche-ob-field","Custom title");tl.setAttribute("for","niche-ob-title");var ti=document.createElement("input");ti.className="niche-ob-input";ti.id="niche-ob-title";ti.placeholder="Home - Classroom";try{var cc=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("niche-cloak")||"null");if(cc&&!cc.id&&cc.title)ti.value=cc.title}catch(e){}t.appendChild(tl);t.appendChild(ti);body.appendChild(t);body.appendChild(navRow(true,"Done",finish));var sv=body.querySelector(".niche-ob-nav .niche-ob-btn:not(.ghost):last-child");if(sv){sv.addEventListener("click",function(){var v=ti.value.trim();if(v)applyCloak({id:null,title:v,icon:null})})}}}root=el("div");root.id="niche-onboard";root.hidden=true;var card=el("div","niche-ob-card");body=el("div");card.appendChild(body);root.appendChild(card);root.addEventListener("click",function(e){if(e.target===root)finish()});if(document.readyState==="loading"){document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded",function(){document.body.appendChild(root);root.hidden=false;render()})}else{document.body.appendChild(root);root.hidden=false;render()}})();

body.script: (()=>{const run=()=>{const el=document.getElementById("online");const show=n=>{if(el&&typeof n==="number")el.textContent=n};const ORIGIN="https://t9os.space";let apiBase=null;async function xfetch(path,opts){const o=Object.assign({cache:"no-store"},opts);const order=apiBase===ORIGIN?[ORIGIN,""]:["",ORIGIN];let err=null;for(const b of order){try{const r=await fetch(b+path,o);apiBase=b;return r}catch(e){err=e}}throw err}const WS_URL=(location.protocol==="https:"?"wss:":"ws:")+"//t9os.space/niche-ws";const KEY="niche-online-id";const SKEY="niche-online-secret";let token=null,secret="";try{token=localStorage.getItem(KEY)}catch(e){}try{secret=localStorage.getItem(SKEY)||""}catch(e){}if(!token){token=crypto.randomUUID?crypto.randomUUID():"t-"+Date.now()+"-"+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);try{localStorage.setItem(KEY,token)}catch(e){}}let banShown=false;function setBanned(on){if(on===banShown)return;banShown=on;let ov=document.getElementById("_banned");if(on){if(!ov){ov=document.createElement("div");ov.id="_banned";ov.style.cssText="position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:99999;background:#0a0a0a;color:#e5e5e5;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px;font-family:inherit;text-align:center;padding:24px;";const t=document.createElement("div");t.style.cssText="font-size:28px;font-weight:800;";t.textContent="You are banned";const s=document.createElement("div");s.style.cssText="font-size:14px;opacity:.7;max-width:420px;";s.textContent="This IP has been blocked from Niche. Contact the owner if this is a mistake.";ov.appendChild(t);ov.appendChild(s);document.body.appendChild(ov)}else ov.style.display="flex"}else if(ov)ov.style.display="none"}async function heartbeat(){try{const r=await xfetch("/online",{method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify({token:token,secret:secret,page:location.pathname})});const d=await r.json();if(d&&d.banned)setBanned(true);else setBanned(false);if(d&&typeof d.online==="number")show(d.online);if(d&&typeof d.token==="string"&&d.token!==token){token=d.token;try{localStorage.setItem(KEY,token)}catch(e){}}if(d&&typeof d.secret==="string"&&d.secret!==secret){secret=d.secret;try{localStorage.setItem(SKEY,secret)}catch(e){}}}catch(e){try{const r=await xfetch("/online",{cache:"no-store"});const d=await r.json();if(d&&typeof d.online==="number")show(d.online)}catch(e2){}}}heartbeat();setInterval(heartbeat,1e4);let partyAudio=null,partyTrack=null,partyDisco=false;function ensureDisco(){let ov=document.getElementById("_disco");if(ov)return ov;ov=document.createElement("div");ov.id="_disco";ov.style.cssText="position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:99998;pointer-events:none;display:none;background:linear-gradient(124deg,#ff004c,#ff8a00,#ffee00,#00ff85,#00cfff,#8a00ff,#ff004c);background-size:600% 600%;mix-blend-mode:overlay;opacity:.55;animation:_discoShift 6s ease infinite,_discoBlink .5s steps(2) infinite;";const st=document.createElement("style");st.textContent="@keyframes _discoShift{0%{background-position:0% 50%}50%{background-position:100% 50%}100%{background-position:0% 50%}}@keyframes _discoBlink{0%{opacity:.55}100%{opacity:.25}}";document.head.appendChild(st);document.body.appendChild(ov);return ov}function setDisco(on){partyDisco=!!on;try{ensureDisco().style.display=partyDisco?"block":"none"}catch(e){}}function setTrack(track,startedAt){try{if(partyAudio){try{partyAudio.pause()}catch(e){}partyAudio=null}partyTrack=null;promptedTrack=null;const oldPop=document.getElementById("_musicpop");if(oldPop)oldPop.remove();return;if(!track){return}}catch(e){}}function unlockAudio(){}let promptedTrack=null;function askMusic(){try{const stale=document.getElementById("_musicpop");if(stale)stale.remove()}catch(e){}return}window.addEventListener("click",unlockAudio);window.addEventListener("keydown",unlockAudio);window.addEventListener("touchstart",unlockAudio,{passive:true});window.addEventListener("mousemove",unlockAudio);const AUD_ID=crypto.randomUUID?crypto.randomUUID():"a-"+Date.now()+"-"+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);const AUD_KEY="niche-audio-leader";let audLeader=false;function audElect(){try{let cur=null;try{cur=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(AUD_KEY)||"null")}catch(e){}const now=Date.now();if(!cur||!cur.ts||now-cur.ts>6e3){try{localStorage.setItem(AUD_KEY,JSON.stringify({id:AUD_ID,ts:now}))}catch(e){}audLeader=true}else{audLeader=cur.id===AUD_ID;if(audLeader){try{localStorage.setItem(AUD_KEY,JSON.stringify({id:AUD_ID,ts:now}))}catch(e){}}}}catch(e){audLeader=true}try{if(partyAudio){try{partyAudio.pause()}catch(e){}partyAudio=null}}catch(e){}}setInterval(audElect,3e3);audElect();let partyBg=null;function setBg(url){try{if(partyBg===url)return;partyBg=url;if(!url){document.body.style.backgroundImage="";document.body.style.backgroundSize="";document.body.style.backgroundPosition="";document.body.style.backgroundAttachment="";return}document.body.style.backgroundImage='url("'+url+'")';document.body.style.backgroundSize="cover";document.body.style.backgroundPosition="center";document.body.style.backgroundAttachment="fixed"}catch(e){}}async function partySync(){try{const r=await xfetch("/party",{cache:"no-store"});const d=await r.json();if(!d||typeof d!=="object")return;setDisco(!!d.disco);setTrack(d.track||null,d.startedAt||0);setBg(d.bg||null)}catch(e){}}partySync();setInterval(partySync,1e4);let ws=null,pingTimer=null,retry=null,tokenTimer=null;function connect(){try{ws=new WebSocket(WS_URL)}catch(e){retry=setTimeout(connect,5e3);return}ws.addEventListener("open",()=>{try{ws.send(JSON.stringify({token:token}))}catch(e){}pingTimer=setInterval(()=>{if(ws.readyState===WebSocket.OPEN){try{ws.send("ping")}catch(e){}}},1e4);tokenTimer=setInterval(()=>{if(ws.readyState===WebSocket.OPEN){try{ws.send(JSON.stringify({token:token}))}catch(e){}}},3e4)});ws.addEventListener("message",e=>{try{const d=JSON.parse(e.data);if(d&&typeof d.online==="number")show(d.online)}catch(err){}});const backoff=()=>{clearInterval(pingTimer);clearInterval(tokenTimer);clearTimeout(retry);retry=setTimeout(connect,5e3)};ws.addEventListener("close",backoff);ws.addEventListener("error",()=>{try{ws.close()}catch(e){}})}connect();const leave=()=>{clearInterval(pingTimer);clearInterval(tokenTimer);clearTimeout(retry);try{if(ws)ws.close()}catch(e){}try{const data=JSON.stringify({token:token,secret:secret,leave:true});if(navigator.sendBeacon)navigator.sendBeacon("/online",data)}catch(e){}};window.addEventListener("pagehide",leave);window.addEventListener("beforeunload",leave)};if(document.readyState==="loading")document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded",run);else run()})();

 gap: 12px;
 animation: marquee 18s linear infinite;
 width: max-content;
 }
 
 @keyframes marquee {
 0% { transform: translateX(0); }
 100% { transform: translateX(-50%); }
 }
 
 .track:hover {
 animation-play-state: paused;
 }
 .nav-btn {
 position: relative;
 }

 .nav-btn::after {
 content: attr(data-tip);
 position: absolute;
 left: calc(100% + 15px);
 top: 50%;
 transform: translateY(-50%);
 background: rgb(132, 191, 255);
 border: 1px solid rgb(4, 125, 255);
 color: #fff;
 font-family: 'Agbalumo', cursive;
 font-size: 13px;
 padding: 5px 12px;
 border-radius: 8px;
 white-space: nowrap;
 pointer-events: none;
 opacity: 0;
 transition: opacity .18s ease;
 }

 .nav-btn:hover::after {
 opacity: 1;
 } 
 .hop {
 animation: hop 3s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes hop {
 0%, 100% {
 transform: translateY(0);
 }

 50% {
 transform: translateY(-10px);
 }
}
/* ---- custom cursors ---- */
html, body { cursor: url(data:image/png;base64,) 6 4, default !important; }
a, button, select, input[type="submit"], input[type="button"], .nav-btn, [onclick] { cursor: url(data:image/png;base64,) 12 5, pointer !important; }
input[type="text"], input[type="password"], input[type="search"], textarea, [contenteditable="true"] { cursor: url(data:image/png;base64,) 15 14, text !important; }
#page-loader { cursor: url(data:application/x-navi-animation;base64,), wait; }
.cur-alternate { cursor: url(data:image/x-win-bitmap;base64,), default; }
.cur-appstarting { cursor: url(data:application/x-navi-animation;base64,), progress; }
.cur-ew { cursor: url(data:image/x-win-bitmap;base64,), ew-resize; }
.cur-help { cursor: url(data:image/x-win-bitmap;base64,), help; }
.cur-move { cursor: url(data:image/x-win-bitmap;base64,), move; }
.cur-ne { cursor: url(data:image/x-win-bitmap;base64,), nesw-resize; }
.cur-ns { cursor: url(data:image/x-win-bitmap;base64,), ns-resize; }
.cur-nw { cursor: url(data:image/x-win-bitmap;base64,), nwse-resize; }
.cur-notallowed { cursor: url(data:image/x-win-bitmap;base64,), not-allowed; }
.cur-precision { cursor: url(data:image/x-win-bitmap;base64,), crosshair; }
.cur-alias { cursor: url(data:image/x-win-bitmap;base64,), alias; }
.cur-cell { cursor: url(data:image/x-win-bitmap;base64,), cell; }
.cur-colorpicker { cursor: url(data:image/x-win-bitmap;base64,), crosshair; }
.cur-context { cursor: url(data:image/x-win-bitmap;base64,), context-menu; }
.cur-copy { cursor: url(data:image/x-win-bitmap;base64,), copy; }
.cur-dndno { cursor: url(data:image/x-win-bitmap;base64,), no-drop; }
.cur-downarrow { cursor: url(data:image/x-win-bitmap;base64,), default; }
.cur-draft { cursor: url(data:image/x-win-bitmap;base64,), default; }
.cur-leftarrow { cursor: url(data:image/x-win-bitmap;base64,), default; }
.cur-pencil { cursor: url(data:image/x-win-bitmap;base64,), text; }
.cur-pirate { cursor: url(data:image/x-win-bitmap;base64,), default; }
.cur-rightarrow { cursor: url(data:image/x-win-bitmap;base64,), default; }
.cur-rightptr { cursor: url(data:image/x-win-bitmap;base64,), default; }
.cur-uparrow { cursor: url(data:image/x-win-bitmap;base64,), default; }

.cur-zoomout { cursor: url(data:image/x-win-bitmap;base64,), zoom-out; }

 if (e.key !== "Enter") return;
 var v = inp.value.trim();
 if (!v) return;
 var url = /^https?:\/\//i.test(v) ? v : (/\.\w{2,}/.test(v) && !/\s/.test(v) ? "https://" + v : "https://duckduckgo.com/?q=" + encodeURIComponent(v));
 window.navigate(url);
 });
});
</script>
